Please investigate and gather detailed information on:
1. Destination & Beach Quality: Why Weihai and Yantai are ideal in July (temperature, water temperature, sand quality). Key beaches like Weihai International Bathing Beach, Half Moon Bay (Banyue Wan), Torch 8th Street, Yangma Island in Yantai, and Chengshantou. Evaluate gentle sand, safe swimming areas, and landscape photography spots (sunrise/sunset, coastal cliffs, seagull spots/shipwrecks like Bluevis).
2. Accommodation Options: Top-rated, accessible hotels and resorts with outstanding service and breakfast buffets, minimal stairs/step-free access, elevator/wheelchair accessibility, and beachfront location. Specific targets: Weihai Bluestone/Bliss International Hotel, Grand New Century Hotel Weihai, Dusit Thani Wetland Resort Weihai, Hyatt Regency Qingdao/Yantai Sheraton/Hilton Yantai Golden Coast. Detail accessibility, breakfast reputation, and value.
3. Dining Options: Restaurants offering fresh Shandong/Northern seafood, family-friendly dining, and heartier Northern/Northeastern Chinese cuisine (e.g., seafood dumplings, mackerel dumplings, seafood barbecue, braised sea cucumber, iron pot stew). Recommend specific highly rated restaurants and seafood markets with processing services.
4. Activity & Itinerary Details: Specific activities for the middle-school boy (e.g., jet skiing, paddleboarding, beach volleyball, sea kayaking, go-karting, marine science), photography locations for the photographer (sunrise at Banyue Wan / Chengshantou, sunset at Torch 8th Street / Grape Beach), and relaxed low-intensity options for elderly parents (coastal golf cart tours, flat seaside boardwalks, scenic drives along Huancui / Coast Road).
5. Practical Logistics & Verification Links: Detailed transport advice (car rental vs local taxi/Didi vs chartered private van for multi-generational family), parking ease, and links to official tourism portals, hotel websites, or major booking platforms (Ctrip/Trip.com, Marriott, Hilton, Accor, Hyatt, etc.).
